Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com; Priya Gupta <pgupta@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & onboarding — Redwood

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising. Procurement at Acme wants to kick off vendor onboarding and align on the procurement timeline, compliance checklist, and next steps. Can we schedule a 45-minute kickoff that includes:
- Redwood AE (contracting/pricing)
- Redwood SE (technical onboarding + integration touchpoints)
- Acme procurement (contracts/PO timing)
- Acme security (high level SOC2/architecture discussion)

Our availability this week (PST):
- Wed 3/3: 11:00–12:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu 3/4: 09:00–11:00

If you have a standard onboarding checklist or SOW draft, can you attach it so procurement can review ahead of the meeting?

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Sr. IT Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
[Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf (12KB)]

Samir — thanks for the note and great to hear procurement wants to move forward.

We can absolutely run that kickoff. Proposed 45-minute slot: Wed 3/3 15:00–15:45 PST. That gives us time to prep and share the SOW + onboarding checklist in advance.

I'll invite the following from our side:
- Aditya Rao (AE) — contracting/pricing
- Dev Patel (SE) — integration plan and technical owners
- Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops) — procurement paperwork and SOW coordination

Attachments: 1) Redwood_Onboarding_Attachments.pdf — includes standard onboarding timeline, required evidence for procurement and security, and SOW template. 2) SOC2-Summary.pdf — brief.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) Procurement timeline & PO requirements (10m)
3) Security/compliance overview & evidence requests (10m)
4) Technical handoff: integration owners, data flows, timelines (15m)
5) Next steps & action items (5m)

If that time works for you I'll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign link for the SOW draft to speed review. If you prefer an earlier slot Wed morning (11:00) we can move — please confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Attachments.pdf (55KB), SOC2-Summary.pdf (215KB)]

Thanks all — I can join Wed 3/3 15:00 PST. I'll bring the SOW draft (attached) and a pricing summary. To set expectations on timelines: once SOW is signed, typical PO and provisioning timeline for Dedicated/Private customers is 10–15 business days for legal and procurement sign-off, and 2–3 weeks to provision and validate capacity depending on the region.

Action items from our side before the call:
- Send SOW draft in DocuSign (Marissa) — to allow redlines
- SE prep: attach network/arch note for private deployment (Dev)
- Sales Ops: confirm billing/legal contacts and standard payment terms (Lauren)

See you on the call.
